fixed.summary: A page served with a strict Content-Security-Policy (`style-src 'self'`, no `'unsafe-inline'`, as a platform's page is) no longer refuses the accessibility mirror's style: it added an inline `<style>` element, so the browser logged a `style-src-elem` violation and drew the mirrored sliders' native thumbs and tracks over the canvas. Its rules are now a constructed stylesheet the document adopts.
